App.name: Industrial SAS
App.description: Warehouse management system for Thai manufacturers

InboundBoard.title: Inbound control board
InboundBoard.description: Track warehouse work after a purchase order is created, from receiving through quality and putaway.
InboundBoard.label: Inbound workflow board
InboundBoard.systemDriven: Stages update from recorded warehouse transactions. Open a card to complete the next controlled step; dragging cannot bypass receiving, quality approval, or ledger posting.
InboundBoard.cardCount: {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} on this page

Connection.label: Server connection
Connection.connectedHint: The server has acknowledged this client.
Connection.connectingHint: No server acknowledgement yet. Stock-confirming work stays unavailable.
Connection.disconnectedHint: The connection dropped. Stock-confirming work stops until it is restored.
Connection.notConfiguredHint: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is unset, so there is no server connection.
Connection.previewHint: Showing synthetic local data. Nothing here came from a server.

Access.organizationRequiredBody: Your account is signed in but has no active organization. Ask an administrator to add or activate your membership.

Workspace.unavailableHint: Organization and warehouse context comes only from a verified token, so it cannot be chosen until an identity provider is configured.
Workspace.previewNotice: The organization and warehouses below are synthetic local development data.

Preview.bannerBody: Every number on this screen is synthetic data generated in the browser. It never passed through the server ledger, and this mode only exists in development.

Setup.title: Setup incomplete
Setup.intro: This application depends on external services that are not configured on this machine.
Setup.convexBody: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL so the browser can reach a Convex deployment.
Setup.identityBody: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is unset, so there is no verified token and every tenant-bound function denies the request.
Setup.envHint: Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in the values you need.
Setup.noFakeAuth: This repository has no sign-in bypass. Tenant data always requires a real token the server has verified.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.unavailableBody: Sign-in belongs to the identity provider, which is not configured on this machine.

Panel.emptyHint: The selected warehouse has no rows yet.
Panel.deniedHint: The server refused this request. Request reference: {requestId}
Panel.signInRequiredHint: Tenant data requires a verified token.
Panel.warehouseMissingHint: Every ledger read is scoped to exactly one warehouse.

Table.scrollHint: Scroll the table sideways to see the remaining columns.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: System state and the entry points into warehouse work.
Dashboard.capabilityBody: Local preview includes inventory reads, master data, purchase orders, receiving, quality control, pallet and label evidence, putaway, operations counters, occupancy, and CSV exports. Real tenant data remains blocked until identity and external services are configured.
Dashboard.balancesCard: Read current balances for the selected warehouse.
Dashboard.historyCard: Read the immutable record of posted movements.
Dashboard.noTiles: No counters for this site yet
Dashboard.noTilesHint: Counters appear as receiving, quality, and putaway activity happens here.
Dashboard.tileSuspect: This number may be low: a counter was corrected downwards. Run the verification before relying on it.
Dashboard.tileCumulative: Total since this site was created
Dashboard.receivingCard: Post received lines against an order.
Dashboard.qualityCard: Decide the inspections waiting on a disposition.
Dashboard.putawayCard: Confirm the putaway tasks that are ready.

Inventory.balancesDescription: Current balance of every stock bucket in the selected warehouse. Read-only.
Inventory.historyDescription: The append-only record of posted inventory movements, newest first.
Inventory.readOnlyNotice: This screen never edits a balance. Corrections are posted as reversals.
Inventory.balancesCaption: {count, plural, one {# balance row} other {# balance rows}}

Handheld.title: Operator tasks
Handheld.lookupDescription: Read balances for the selected warehouse.
Handheld.notBuiltYet: This task is not built yet.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This application has no such page.

MasterData.locationsDescription: Storage locations inside the selected warehouse. Read-only.
MasterData.maintainNotice: Every create and edit is authorized on the server. Each request carries an idempotency key and is written to the audit trail.
MasterData.suppliersDescription: The organization's supplier register, referenced when goods are received.
MasterData.storageClassesDescription: Storage requirements that mean the same thing at every site, such as flammable or heavy-duty racking.
MasterData.labelTemplatesDescription: Versioned label template text. Nothing here is connected to a printer and nothing is rendered.
MasterData.itemDetailDescription: Barcodes, alternate units, and lots for this item.
MasterData.itemNotFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this item is not part of the preview data.
MasterData.storageClassesCaption: {count, plural, one {# storage class} other {# storage classes}}
MasterData.itemUomsCaption: {count, plural, one {# alternate unit} other {# alternate units}}, against a base of {baseUom}
MasterData.labelTemplatesCaption: {count, plural, one {# template version} other {# template versions}}
MasterData.codeHint: A code identifier: letters and digits, unique within the organization.
MasterData.baseUomHint: The base unit is set once, at creation: every balance ever posted is stored in it.
MasterData.trackingModeHint: Lot and serial tracking is disabled this milestone; an item in that mode cannot be received yet.
MasterData.barcodeHint: A GTIN's check digit is verified and the value padded to 14 digits. Other kinds are stored as entered.
MasterData.uomHint: The alternate unit's code. It must differ from the item's base unit.
MasterData.denominatorHint: Stored as two whole numbers so a ratio like 200/3 stays exact instead of being rounded.
MasterData.businessDateHint: A business date in the warehouse's own timezone, as YYYY-MM-DD — not this device's timezone.
MasterData.bodyHint: The text is stored exactly as entered. Nothing parses it, previews it, or sends it to a printer.
MasterData.supplierFormDescription: The code is unique within your organization. Another tenant may hold the same one.
MasterData.storageClassFormDescription: A storage class means the same thing at every warehouse in the organization.
MasterData.templateFormDescription: The version number is assigned by the server, and publishing requires a different person to approve it.
MasterData.barcodeFormDescription: One barcode resolves to at most one item within the organization.
MasterData.uomFormDescription: The factor is always expressed against the base unit, {baseUom}.
MasterData.lotFormDescription: The lot code is unique within this item.
MasterData.itemFormDescription: The SKU and the base unit are set once and cannot be changed.
MasterData.itemEditDescription: Only the name and tracking mode can change. The SKU and base unit cannot.
MasterData.locationFormDescription: The location is created in the warehouse currently selected.
MasterData.selectTrackingMode: Choose how this item is tracked
MasterData.selectLocationType: Choose what this location is used for
MasterData.selectFormat: Choose the printer language of this template
MasterData.selectBarcodeKind: Choose where this barcode came from

Write.selectReasonCode: Choose the reason this is being recorded
Write.noReasonCodesHint: A master-data administrator adds the reason codes this step needs.
Write.submittingHint: The request has been sent and is awaiting an answer.
Write.savedHint: The server wrote the row and recorded it in the audit trail.
Write.savedReplayedHint: This request had already succeeded. The server returned the same result and created nothing new.
Write.demonstratedHint: The form works end to end, but nothing was sent to a server and nothing was stored.
Write.deniedHint: No reason is given. Quote this request reference to an administrator: {requestId}
Write.failedHint: Whether the request was applied is unknown. Submitting again is safe: the same idempotency key is reused.

WriteError.FIELD_INVALID: A value did not pass validation. Check the marked field.
WriteError.DUPLICATE_KEY: Something in your organization already uses this code.
WriteError.NOT_FOUND: The row being changed does not exist.
WriteError.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Something this refers to does not exist in your organization.
WriteError.REQUEST_ARGUMENT_CONFLICT: This request reference was already used with different values. Start a new request.
WriteError.REQUEST_IDENTITY_INVALID: The request reference is not valid.
WriteError.REPLAY_RESULT_UNVERIFIABLE: The earlier request's result could not be confirmed. Check the register before retrying.
WriteError.REPLAY_TARGET_MISSING: The row the earlier request created no longer exists.
WriteError.UNKNOWN: The server refused the request without a readable code.

Purchasing.ordersDescription: Orders for the selected warehouse. Receiving posts against these.
Purchasing.orderDescription: The order's lines, with what has been received and what is outstanding.
Purchasing.importDescription: Review the parse first, then write it in chunks. Re-running a chunk creates nothing new.
Purchasing.orderNotFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this order is not part of the preview data.
Purchasing.formDescription: The order stays a draft until it has at least one line.
Purchasing.lineFormDescription: The quantity is converted to the item's base unit through that item's own conversion table.
Purchasing.closeShortHint: A reason code is required: it is the evidence for why the supplier under-delivered.
Purchasing.importBatchRefHint: Half of every row's idempotency key. It must differ from any other file.
Purchasing.importTextHint: The first line must be the header: line_number, sku, quantity, uom.
Purchasing.importPreviewDescription: This step only reads the file. Nothing is written until a chunk is written below.
Purchasing.importAcceptedCaption: {count, plural, one {# row parsed} other {# rows parsed}}
Purchasing.importRejectedCaption: {count, plural, one {# row with a problem} other {# rows with problems}}
Purchasing.importApplyDescription: One bounded chunk per press. Rows already written are skipped.
Purchasing.importProgress: {applied} of {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} written
Purchasing.importSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row was skipped because it was already written} other {# rows were skipped because they were already written}}
Purchasing.importEmpty: No row in this file can be written.
Purchasing.noPreviewYetHint: Enter a file reference and contents, then check it to see the parse before writing anything.
Purchasing.importProgressPreview: {applied} of {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} walked — preview mode stored nothing
Purchasing.importCompletePreview: Every row walked — preview mode stored nothing
Purchasing.importOrderHint: The open order the file's lines are written into.
Purchasing.noSuppliersHint: Add a supplier in master data before creating an order.
Purchasing.noItemsHint: Add an item to the register before adding an order line.
Purchasing.selectSupplier: Choose the supplier this order is placed with

Receiving.title: Receiving
Receiving.description: Receipts for the selected warehouse, and the lines posted against them.
Receiving.receiptDescription: The lines received, the pallet built from them, and the label evidence.
Receiving.linesCaption: {count, plural, one {# received line} other {# received lines}}
Receiving.receiptNotFoundHint: The link may be wrong, or this receipt is not part of the preview data.
Receiving.openFormDescription: Choose an order, or leave it blank for a receipt with no order behind it.
Receiving.lineFormDescription: Scan or type the item, quantity, and lot. The server converts the unit and checks the over-receipt tolerance.
Receiving.fieldLotHint: Required for a lot-tracked item, and refused for one that is not tracked.
Receiving.outcomeHeld: This line landed in QC hold and an inspection has been opened for it.
Receiving.overToleranceHint: An over-receipt needs a second person through a separate permission, so nothing was posted.
Receiving.exceptionDescription: The person who raises it and the person who receives against it must differ; the server refuses otherwise.
Receiving.palletDescription: Building a pallet moves no stock. It is a way of referring to lines already received.
Receiving.handheldDescription: Pick an order, open a receipt, then scan one line at a time.
Receiving.selectOrderFirstHint: Every ordinary receipt posts against an order line; exceptions need somebody to raise them.
Receiving.noOpenLines: This order has no line still open
Receiving.noOpenLinesHint: Every line is complete, closed short, or cancelled.
Receiving.noReceivingLocations: This warehouse has no receiving location
Receiving.noReceivingLocationsHint: At least one dock or staging location is needed. A master-data administrator adds it.
Receiving.noOpenOrders: No order is open for receiving
Receiving.noOpenOrdersHint: An order needs at least one line before it can be received against.
Receiving.receiptUnavailableHint: Open a receipt and the capture step follows automatically.
Receiving.noPalletLines: No received line to build a pallet from
Receiving.noPalletLinesHint: Post at least one received line first.
Receiving.labelTargetMissingHint: Build a pallet first; the label is generated for it.
Receiving.noTemplatesHint: A template has to be published by a second person before a payload can be generated.
Receiving.demonstrationReceiptHint: No receipt was created. The capture step below works against the sample receipt {receiptId} so the scan, unit, and lot fields can be walked through; nothing it submits is stored either.
Receiving.scanItemHint: A barcode or a SKU. Resolved against this tenant's catalogue; pressing Enter resolves the scan and never posts the line.
Receiving.scanUnknownHint: No active barcode or SKU of this organization matches it. Check the label, or choose the item below.
Receiving.scanNotOnOrder: Scanned item is not on this order
Receiving.scanNotOnOrderHint: The ordinary path only posts items the order asked for. Raise a receiving exception for an unexpected item so a second person can decide.
Receiving.fieldItemChoiceHint: Only the items this order asked for. Anything else goes through a receiving exception.
Receiving.noItems: No active items in the catalogue
Receiving.noItemsHint: A master-data administrator has to create the items before a delivery can be received against them.
Receiving.selectLocation: Choose the dock or staging lane the goods arrived at
Receiving.selectOrderLine: Choose the order line being received
Receiving.selectItemChoice: Choose one of the items this order asked for
Receiving.selectExceptionKind: Choose what went wrong with the delivery

Quality.title: Quality
Quality.description: The inspection queue for the selected warehouse, and its dispositions.
Quality.caption: {count, plural, one {# inspection} other {# inspections}}
Quality.dispositionDescription: Every disposition is a balanced stock movement, not a status edit.
Quality.approveHint: Needs a different person from the one who recorded it, and a re-verified session.
Quality.approvalRule: A second person has to approve
Quality.selectDisposition: Choose what the stock should become
Quality.pendingHint: Release and scrap need an approver. The stock stays held until then.
Quality.handheldDescription: See what is waiting to be inspected, and record a decision.
Quality.noTaskSelectedHint: Pick an inspection from the queue to record a decision.
Quality.noPendingInspectionsHint: An inspection arrives here when somebody records a release or a scrap.
Quality.selectPending: Choose an inspection waiting for approval

Putaway.title: Putaway
Putaway.description: Putaway tasks for the selected warehouse, with the reasoning behind each recommendation.
Putaway.caption: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
Putaway.claimedHint: Another operator holds this task. If it is yours, claim it again after reconnecting.
Putaway.recommendationCaption: {count, plural, one {# location} other {# locations}} passed the filters, best first
Putaway.rejectedCaption: {count, plural, one {# location was} other {# locations were}} filtered out
Putaway.confirmDescription: Taking anything other than the top recommendation needs a reason code.
Putaway.selectChosenLocation: Choose the bin the stock was actually put in
Putaway.fieldOverrideReason: Reason for not taking the recommendation
Putaway.overrideNotice: Recorded as an override, together with the location the system recommended.
Putaway.noTaskSelectedHint: Pick a task from the board to see its recommendation and confirm it.
Putaway.handheldDescription: Claim a task, read the recommendation, and confirm when it is on the rack.
Putaway.noRankedLocationsHint: Claim the task so the recommendation is stored, or no location satisfies the storage constraints.

LabelEvidence.caption: {count, plural, one {# label record} other {# label records}}
LabelEvidence.generateDescription: The payload is built from a published template version, and its hash is kept as evidence.
LabelEvidence.printerBoundaryHint: The payload is generated and stored only. Nothing is sent to a printer, nothing is previewed, and no label has been physically printed or rescanned.

PutawayFilterReason.LOCATION_TYPE_NOT_STORAGE: Not a storage location — a dock or staging lane
PutawayFilterReason.STORAGE_CLASS_INCOMPATIBLE: Storage class does not match what the item needs
PutawayFilterReason.STOCK_STATUS_NOT_PUTAWAYABLE: Stock in this status cannot go to a normal bin

ImportProblem.COLUMN_COUNT_MISMATCH: Column count does not match the header
ImportProblem.QUANTITY_NOT_POSITIVE: Quantity must be greater than zero
ImportProblem.QUANTITY_TOO_PRECISE: More than the three decimal places the ledger stores

Occupancy.caption: Locations in code order. Each cell shows the code, how full it is, and how many distinct stock buckets it holds.
Occupancy.empty: No locations configured at this site
Occupancy.emptyHint: A master-data administrator has to create locations before the map can show anything.
Occupancy.partial: This map does not show every location
Occupancy.partialHint: The site has more locations than one page of the map. What is drawn is accurate; what is missing is not empty.
Occupancy.capacity: Share of drawn locations by band

Reports.title: Exports
Reports.description: Ask for a spreadsheet of this site's data. Exports run in bounded steps, so a large one makes visible progress instead of timing out.
Reports.requestDescription: The job is created immediately; the walk over the data happens one page at a time.
Reports.noJobsHint: A requested export appears here with its progress and, once finished, its file.
Reports.advanceDemonstrated: Nothing was written. Preview mode demonstrates the step without running the export.
Reports.failureArtifactLimit: Stopped because the file would have been incomplete. Narrow the export rather than treating this as a retry.
Reports.deliveryBoundary: Files are downloaded from this session, not from a signed link
Reports.deliveryBoundaryHint: Short-lived signed download links need a file-storage provider that is not configured yet. Until then the file is fetched through a permission-checked read and saved by your browser, so it cannot be forwarded as a link.
Reports.advanceDenied: You may not run this export. Quote this request ID when asking for access:
Reports.advanceRefused: The export did not advance. Nothing was appended, and pressing again will not change the answer:
Reports.advanceFailed: The request did not reach the server. Nothing was appended; press again to retry.

OrderToShip.salesDescription: Capture the customer PO, classify every product by customer product code, and hand new designs to Engineering.
OrderToShip.engineeringDescription: Own due design work, complete the structured master card, and submit immutable revisions for independent release.
OrderToShip.factoryDescription: Use only released revision snapshots with approved files, route, quality requirements, and order references.
OrderToShip.flowSalesDetail: Customer and customer product code decide exact reuse. Geometry can only suggest a design for human confirmation.
OrderToShip.flowEngineeringDetail: Engineering records structure, route, materials, calculations, quality and private files; a second person releases it.
OrderToShip.flowFactoryDetail: The factory receives one immutable packet with SO/PO references, approved files and the released route.
OrderToShip.salesRegisterDetail: Draft and released customer commitments, ordered most recently first.
OrderToShip.engineeringQueueDetail: Priority, due state, product identity and specification readiness stay visible together.
OrderToShip.factoryQueueDetail: Printable packet snapshots; no engineering-table permission is required on the floor.
OrderToShip.newOrderDetail: Enter the sales-order identity. Customer product codes and line specifications are added after the order is saved.
OrderToShip.customerIdHint: Use the customer ID from the customer register; the server verifies that it belongs to this organization.
OrderToShip.masterCardEditorDetail: Capture the first structured row for paper, route, material, quality and calculation evidence. A verified private file and an independent approver are still required before release.
OrderToShip.commaSeparatedHint: Enter multiple values separated by commas or new lines.
OrderToShip.layerRowsHint: One layer per line: position | paper code | gsm.
OrderToShip.routeRowsHint: One step per line: sequence | work centre | operation | instruction.
OrderToShip.materialRowsHint: One material per line: item | description | quantity | unit | waste percent.
OrderToShip.qualityRowsHint: One check per line: code | description | target | tolerance.
OrderToShip.calculationRowsHint: One calculation per line: name | formula version | input name | input value | input unit | result | result unit | PASS/FAIL.
OrderToShip.addOrderLineDetail: Customer product identity controls exact reuse; geometry is advisory only.
OrderToShip.releaseOrderDetail: Commit the validated order while any new design continues through Engineering.
OrderToShip.confirmSimilarDetail: Similarity never reuses automatically. An authorized person must name the released revision and record why it is acceptable.
OrderToShip.masterCardLibraryDetail: Open a card to compare immutable revisions, submit or decide a revision, and manage its private files.
OrderToShip.previewRevisionHistory: Revision history is connected in server mode. Preview mode never invents release evidence or private files.
OrderToShip.revisionLoadFailed: Revision history could not be loaded.
OrderToShip.previousRevisionOnEarlierPage: The preceding revision is on the previous page.
OrderToShip.noStructuralChanges: No structured specification changes from the preceding revision.
OrderToShip.revisionActionsAndFiles: Revision actions, comparison and private files
OrderToShip.releasedFilesReadOnly: Released revision files are immutable and available for audited download only.
OrderToShip.draftChangedRevisionDetail: The current revision remains immutable. Edit the prefilled structured fields to create the next draft.
OrderToShip.fileUploadFailed: Upload or verification failed. The file was not attached.
OrderToShip.fileAccessFailed: File access was refused or the object is unavailable.
OrderToShip.previewSimilarityCandidates: Server mode shows ranked released designs here. Preview never auto-selects a candidate.
OrderToShip.candidateLoadFailed: Similar-design candidates could not be loaded.
OrderToShip.noSimilarCandidates: No released designs are similar enough to suggest.
OrderToShip.similarCandidatesDetail: Suggestions are separate from exact reuse and require a reasoned human confirmation.

StorageLayouts.title: Storage building planner
StorageLayouts.description: Plan warehouse buildings, floor envelopes, and space unavailable for storage.
StorageLayouts.emptyBody: Create a building to start defining floor-by-floor capacity.
StorageLayouts.noMatchesBody: Change the search text or status filter to see more buildings.
StorageLayouts.planningNoticeBody: They define physical dimensions and usable floor space; they do not change inventory locations or stock.
StorageLayouts.name: Building name
StorageLayouts.reviewDescription: Confirm every floor and calculated capacity before making this layout active.
StorageLayouts.loadError: The storage layout could not be loaded.
StorageLayouts.saved: Floor saved. Building totals were recalculated.
StorageLayouts.writeError: The change could not be saved: {code}
StorageLayouts.validationPassed: Dimensions, floor sequence, reserved zones, and usable areas passed validation.
